notes.title: 🌟 Extra DLC Release! 🍭
notes.notes:
Hey, little critters!

The Extra DLC pack is finally here!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3582580/Artificial_Fashionista__Extra_Collection/

This pack is the biggest one so far, containing 9 outfits with over 70 individual items!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44970742/7654b3a11468d6608bb20e66947902af877eeb2d.png

Huge thanks to Boonie for designing the Retrofuture outfit, and amii for designing the Butterfly outfit. I had a lot of fun bringing your visions to life!

🌟 Steam Deck Verified
I also made a bunch of improvements under the hood, which allowed Artificial Fashionista to become Steam Deck Verified:

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44970742/fb20d7e782ff9c2a883084555c22b7cbac7dd90f.png

🌟 Patch Notes
Here's everything that's new and improved in Version 3.2:

 New Item: Sparkle eyes!
 New Aspect Ratio settings!
 3 New Hair Colors: Salmon, Teal, and Platinum Blonde!
 Improved the sharpness of images on smaller screens.
 Made the hair color palette smaller so it's visible on one screen.
 Compatibility for new DLC items.
 Search filters now also work on Sets and Backgrounds.
 Changed the layering of the Cutout Leotard & Monokini to always be in the back.
 Improved layering of various jacket & top combos.
 Moved wings further to the back.
 Replaced some backgrounds.
 Gamepad glyphs are scaled along with the text size setting.
 Fixed the display of hair in the "Worn" screen.
 Fixed filtering with "AND".
 Fixed display errors.

🌟 Bundle
As always, you can also check out these bundles for an added discount!

https://store.steampowered.com/bundle/45143/Artificial_Fashionista__Closet_Expansion/

https://store.steampowered.com/bundle/49171/?snr=1_5_9_

🌟 What's next?
Like I previously announced, the Extra DLC pack was the final one, and I'm extremely grateful for how much love you've shown this little game over the past year. I will dedicate myself fully to Artificial Selection again soon, BUT...

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1389870/Artificial_Selection/

...Before that happens, I have one last major improvement for Artificial Fashionista in the works:

Challenge Rewards. That's right! To give you an additional incentive to play challenge mode, I plan to add an exclusive reward item for beating each individual challenge. 

I'm not sure yet if all rewards of a collection should add up to one complete outfit, or if each challenge should give you a specific accessory matching its own theme, so I'm looking forward to hearing your opinions! Feel free to share your thoughts in the comments, or in the Outfit Ideas discussion. I'd be happy to add that niche item you still think is missing!

Thank you so much for your support!

notes.title: Hair Colors & Belts Update!
notes.notes:
Hey, little critters!

Thanks to a great suggestion in our community, it's time for our first feature update: You can now change Foris' hair color!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44970742/bac4a0a1d6dbef4ee685e2239036ef09e2890f80.png

I also reorganized the clothes a bit, and added the new "Belt" category:

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44970742/dc12605a7fafebb94d2d269d939b4a066aeaa2dc.png

There are 2 new belts to get you started, and it also means you can now combine the towel with pants or skirts (and not just dresses/swimsuits, like before)!

Patch notes:

 Added hair color options!
 Added the "Belt" category with 2 new items!
 Reorganized the categories into "Clothes" (containing tops, bottoms, and bodies) and "Cover" (containing jackets and belts).
 Added the ability to switch between XBOX and PS4 controller icons, or turn them off completely.
 Removed Foris' toes from all slippers. (sorry)
 Added a "Reset" button directly to the "Worn" view.
 Hopefully fixed an achievement bug.


I hope you continue to enjoy Artificial Fashionista, and thank you for your support!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44970742/cf4ac127af632c67119b3fc1fb0cc93df126ca94.png

notes.title: Artificial Fashionista release!
notes.notes:
Hey, little critters!

I'm happy to announce that Artificial Fashionista is now playable on Steam:

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2924880/Artificial_Fashionista

I hope you enjoy hunting all the achievements, and I look forward to seeing your fashionable creations in the community!

It would mean a lot to me if you could leave a review if you enjoyed the game. Every single one helps!
And of course, please report any bugs you come across. I want to make sure Artificial Fashionista can be enjoyed by everyone!

Soundtrack
Unfortunately, there were some delays with the OST, but it will be available as well in a few days:

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2935550/Artificial_Fashionista_Soundtrack/

Related Games
Artificial Fashionista is set in the same world as Artificial Selection. If you're curious about the other characters, there are hours of content you can catch up on in Artificial Selection's demo:

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1389870/Artificial_Selection

Thank you so much for your support, and have fun!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44970742/cf4ac127af632c67119b3fc1fb0cc93df126ca94.png
